test_command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 Rscript -e 'devtools::test(filter = "lognormal-sigma-sd-regression", reporter = "summary", stop_on_failure = TRUE)'
warnings: No test failures, skips, or model diagnostic warnings were reported in the focused run.
scope: Native complete-data LogNormal with fixed mu and one independent numeric random slope on log(sigma), fitted with a group-constant predictor-dependent SD. The fixed-seed synthetic test checks coefficient recovery, selected-target naming, group-level SD predictions, and refusal of a sigma slope without its matching direct-SD formula. It does not establish interval coverage, Julia parity, intercept-plus-slope blocks, or broad LogNormal support.
